body:
Add a clean-room abrasive-waterjet corner slowdown and pierce-timing model from published waterjet engineering literature (Hashish, Zeng and Kim, Momber and Kovacevic, public OMAX notes).

Depends on #1883 (`WaterjetProfile`).

## Scope

- **Physics corner slowdown (`crates/motion/src/waterjet/`):**
  - Model stream lag scaling with thickness and traverse speed without copying any vendor table or third-party Fusion post.
  - Detect sharp corners (deflection angle) and tight curve segments on generated `WaterjetProfile` contours.
  - Compute a thickness-scaled deceleration and acceleration zone length (`3 mm` to `10 mm` range in published practice, clamped per segment).
  - Split moves inside each zone and assign monotonically ramped `Move::feed` values (`crates/cl/src/cl/moves.rs`) down to a configurable minimum speed ratio (`[0.30, 1.0]`).
  - Add an optional sharp-corner catch-up dwell `G4` setting for thick or brittle plate.
  - Keep corner slowdown enabled by default with an operation toggle to turn it off.
- **Pierce and valve sequence parameters:**
  - Validate cut-data pierce dwell, low-pressure/pressure-ramp pierce flag, abrasive lead/lag delay before motion and after cut end, and re-pierce dwell.
  - Write per-span pierce and valve delays into waterjet CL records so posts emit exact `G4` and valve sequences.

**Done means:** `WaterjetProfile` splits approach and departure segments at corners and tight arcs within the thickness-scaled zone, writes bounded `Move::feed` ramps and pierce/valve timing into CL records, and golden tests verify both flat and multi-corner shapes across thin and thick stock.

Part of #1525
